data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 total revenue was about $97.69 billion, up roughly 1% from $96.77 billion in 2023. Gross profit was about $17.45 billion, which works out to a gross margin of roughly 17.9%, down from about 18.2% in 2023. Operating income was about $7.08 billion, giving an operating margin of roughly 7.2%, compared with 9.2% in 2023, when operating income was about $8.89 billion. The decline reflected lower average selling prices and higher operating expenses, partly offset by growth in the energy generation and storage business and in services. These figures come from my recollection of Tesla's 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, so check them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
